findings.subject: skeleton SEAM-GAPS
findings.message: SEAM-BACK-CENTRE: B1 ENVELOPE to B2 ENVELOPE is 0.0 mm, needs at least 1 mm; SEAM-BACK-CORNER-L: L1 ENVELOPE to B1 ENVELOPE is 0.0 mm, needs at least 1 mm; SEAM-BACK-CORNER-R: R1 ENVELOPE to B2 ENVELOPE is 0.0 mm, needs at least 1 mm; SEAM-CEILING-CENTRE: C1 ENVELOPE to C2 ENVELOPE is 0.0 mm, needs at least 1 mm; SEAM-CEILING-SIDE: C1 ENVELOPE to L2 ENVELOPE is 0.0 mm, needs at least 1 mm. Rule source: assumption: 1.0 mm stands in until the joints register gives the compressed gasket thickness. Why: IF-04 asks for a seam gasket between B1 and B2 (and B3, B4); a gasket needs a gap of at least its compressed thickness, and frames cut to plus tolerance must still fit
findings.fix: Joints Engineer: set the compressed gasket thickness per seam. Fusion Engineer 2: add a seam_gap parameter and shrink the panels by it

findings.subject: skeleton KICK-OVER-THRESHOLD
findings.message: KICK-OVER-THRESHOLD: KICK ENVELOPE to THRESHOLD ENVELOPE is 0.0 mm, needs at least 7 mm. Rule source: confirmed: FRONT's 7 mm floor gap for the drop seal, approved by the PM in the FRONT group on 2026-10-31. Why: The door swings over the threshold; with no running gap it rubs, and the drop seal needs the gap to close
findings.fix: Kick strip bottom at the threshold top plus 7 mm (Z 27 with a 20 mm threshold), carried as a skeleton parameter

findings.subject: skeleton door_z0
findings.message: Skeleton P03 parameter door_z0 = 109 (pod_h - dt_h - door_h) is used by nothing and disagrees with door_zb = 105, where the door bottom really is (BUILD-RECORD).
findings.fix: Remove door_z0, or derive it from door_zb so the two can't disagree.

findings.subject: skeleton shell back X -1207..1207 Z 2319..2357
findings.message: The outer shell is open on the back face of the skeleton: nothing covers X -1207 to 1207, Z 2319 to 2357 (a slot 2414 x 38 mm). Bordered by: B3 ENVELOPE, B4 ENVELOPE, C1 ENVELOPE, C2 ENVELOPE, L2 ENVELOPE, R2 ENVELOPE. Checked 1 mm inside the face on a 5 mm grid, bodies as their boxes.
findings.fix: Close it: extend the bordering panels to meet, or add the part that belongs there.

findings.subject: skeleton SEAM-GAPS-HORIZONTAL
findings.message: SEAM-SIDE-HORIZONTAL: L1 ENVELOPE to L2 ENVELOPE is 0.0 mm, needs at least 1 mm; SEAM-BACK-HORIZONTAL: B1 ENVELOPE to B3 ENVELOPE is 0.0 mm, needs at least 1 mm. Rule source: assumption: as SEAM-BACK-CENTRE. Why: IF-04 asks for a seam gasket between the lower and upper side panels; under the upper panel's weight it needs its compressed thickness or a groove
findings.fix: Joints Engineer: say whether the horizontal seams take a gasket in the gap (then a seam_gap) or in a groove (then no gap)

findings.subject: skeleton DR x BAND-R
findings.message: DR's bottom follows the fixed glass bottom (Z 102), 8 mm into the right base band's front end (Z 10 to 110): 14394 mm3 of overlap, on the skeleton's own list of expected clashes as a HOLD for the base design (skeleton P03 BUILD-RECORD, clash check).
findings.fix: BASE: notch the band or stop it short of DR in the base design; the Fusion clash check confirms it on the assembled CAD.
findings.posted: already in the BASE brief (not re-posted)

findings.subject: F-HW
findings.message: F-HW FRONT - SEALED GLAZING PROFILES FOR THE FIXED GLASS (2200 x 120 x 60 mm) doesn't fit the 48x40 pallet it ships on (1219 x 1016, at most 1679 tall loaded above a 150 mm deck); it fits the 48x96 pallet.
findings.fix: Move it to the right pallet in the layout study, or change the piece.
